SFD-001.name: Against the Odds
SFD-001.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Give a friendly unit at a battlefield +2[M] this turn for each enemy unit there.

SFD-004.name: Ambush
SFD-004.rulesText:
[Hidden]
Friendly units enter ready this turn. Play a Gold gear token exhausted.

SFD-005.name: Detonate
SFD-005.rulesText: Kill a gear. Its controller draws 2.
SFD-005.flavorText: Nobody wants to be left holding the exploding end of the stick.

SFD-006.name: Eager Drakehound
SFD-006.flavorText: There are two kinds of drakehound trainer: strict, and dead.

SFD-007.name: Gem Jammer
SFD-007.rulesText: When you play me, give a unit [Ganking] this turn.

SFD-010.name: Void Drone
SFD-010.rulesText: I cost [2] less to play from anywhere other than your hand.
SFD-010.flavorText: Rek'Sai's children appear without warning, ambushing their prey beneath the Shuriman sands.

SFD-011.name: Angle Shot
SFD-011.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose a unit and an Equipment with the same controller. Attach that Equipment to that unit or detach that Equipment from that unit. Draw 1.

SFD-012.name: Battering Ram
SFD-012.rulesText: I cost [1] less for each card you've played this turn, to a minimum of [1].

SFD-013.name: Blast Corps Cadet
SFD-013.rulesText:
You may pay [1][R] as an addtional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield.
SFD-013.flavorText: The bigger the bangs, the less you have to aim.

SFD-014.name: Minotaur Reckoner
SFD-014.flavorText: He is blessed with immense patience, a gift he feels compelled to share.

SFD-015.name: Perched Grimwyrm
SFD-015.rulesText: Play me only to a battlefield you conquered this turn.
SFD-015.flavorText: When you see the Grimwyrm's shadow, it's already too late.

SFD-016.name: Recurve Bow
SFD-016.effectText: When I attack or defend, deal 2 to an enemy unit here. [M]+0

SFD-017.name: Sudden Storm
SFD-017.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield. If it's attacking, deal 4 to it instead.

SFD-018.name: Void Hatchling
SFD-018.rulesText: If you would reveal cards from a deck, look at the top card first. You may recycle it. Then reveal those cards.
SFD-018.flavorText: From the moment of hatching, xer'sai serve their queen.

SFD-019.name: Assembly Rig
SFD-019.rulesText: [1][R], Recycle a unit from your trash, [E]: Play a 3[M] Mech unit token to your base.
SFD-019.flavorText: "Can't believe someone would throw this out!"

SFD-020.name: Draven, Vanquisher
SFD-020.rulesText:
When I win a combat, play a Gold gear token exhausted.
When I attack or defend, you may pay [R]. If you do, give me +2[M] this turn.

SFD-021.name: Ferrous Forerunner
SFD-021.rulesText: [Deathknell] — Play two 3[M] Mech unit tokens to your base.
SFD-021.flavorText: "You are a wreck waiting to happen. I just see parts that aren't spare yet."

SFD-022.name: Long Sword
SFD-022.flavorText: Efforts to create the Longer Sword quickly ran into diminishing returns.

SFD-023.name: Piercing Light
SFD-023.rulesText:
[Repeat] [2][R]
Deal 2 to a unit at a battefield, then deal 2 to up to one other unit.
SFD-023.flavorText:
"I got two good reasons for you to turn back."
—Lucian

SFD-024.name: Rell, Magnetic
SFD-024.rulesText:
[Tank]
When I attack, you may play an Equipment with Energy cost no more than [2], ignoring its cost, and attach it to me.
SFD-024.flavorText: "Bones shatter and people lie, but I can always count on iron."

SFD-025.name: Rengar, Pouncing
SFD-025.rulesText:
[Reaction]
[Assault 2]
I can be played to a battlefield you're attacking.

SFD-026.name: Rumble, Hotheaded
SFD-026.rulesText:
Your Mechs each have [Assault].
When I conquer, you may recycle another friendly unit to play a Mech from your trash. Reduce its Energy cost by the Might of the unit you recycled.

SFD-027.name: Dunebreaker
SFD-027.rulesText:
If you have two or fewer cards in your hand, I enter ready.
When I hold, draw 2.
SFD-027.flavorText: Dunes don't break like branches. They break like waves.

SFD-028.name: Lucian, Gunslinger
SFD-028.rulesText:
[Assault]
When I attack, deal damage equal to my [Assault] to an enemy unit here.
SFD-028.flavorText: "Everybody dies. Some just need a little help."

SFD-029.name: Rek'Sai, Breacher
SFD-029.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
[Assault]
Friendly units played from anywhere other than a player's hand have [Accelerate].

SFD-030.name: Skyfall of Areion
SFD-030.effectText: My hold effects are also conquer effects, and vice versa. [M]+2

SFD-031.name: Desert's Call
SFD-031.rulesText:
[Repeat] [2]
Play a 2[M] Sand Soldier unit token.
SFD-031.flavorText: The Great Sai desert hides as many spears as it does secrets.

SFD-032.name: Disarming Rake
SFD-032.rulesText: When you play me, you may kill a gear.
SFD-032.flavorText: "I like to break things: swords, arms, hearts..."

SFD-035.name: Guardian of the Passage
SFD-035.rulesText: When I hold, you may return a unit or gear from your trash to your hand.
SFD-035.flavorText: In the Shadow Isles, the veil between life and death is thin indeed.

SFD-036.name: Lonely Poro
SFD-036.flavorText:
Far from fluft and all alone
None to mourn but ice and stone
—Ode to a Lonely Poro

SFD-037.name: Navori Scout
SFD-037.flavorText: The Navori Brotherhood has neither a height requirement nor a retirement age.

SFD-038.name: Ribbon Dancer
SFD-038.rulesText: When I move to a battlefield, give another friendly unit +1[M] this turn.
SFD-038.flavorText: A flutter of silk is all the warning her enemies get.

SFD-039.name: Royal Entourage
SFD-039.rulesText: When you play me, ready or exhaust a legend.
SFD-039.flavorText: After the seat of the ancient Shuriman Empire rose from the sands and its immortal emperor stpped out of myth to lead it, those who first embraced his rule were richly rewarded.

SFD-041.name: Apprentice Smith
SFD-041.rulesText: When I move, reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's a gear, draw it. Otherwise, recycle it.
SFD-041.flavorText: "My mentor says every failed project is a lesson. Me, I use 'em as paperweights."

SFD-042.name: Brutalizer
SFD-042.effectText: If this was attached to me this turn, I have an additional +2[M]. [M]+1

SFD-043.name: Emperor's Divide
SFD-043.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Move any number of friendly units at a battlefield to their base.
SFD-043.flavorText: The sands of battle shift at Azir's command.

SFD-044.name: Legion Quartermaster
SFD-044.rulesText: As an additional cost to play me, return a friendly gear to its owner's hand.
SFD-044.flavorText: "An ancient runeblade! Very rare. Take it to Tent 3 for processing."

SFD-045.name: Not So Fast
SFD-045.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Counter an enemy spell or ability that chooses a friendly unit or gear.

SFD-046.name: Poro Snax
SFD-046.rulesText:
When you play this, draw 1.
[1][G], [E], Kill this: Draw 1.

SFD-047.name: Simian Ancestor
SFD-047.rulesText: When you buff me, ready me.
SFD-047.flavorText: "I'm faster than I look. Older too, if you can believe it."

SFD-048.name: Stellacorn Herder
SFD-048.flavorText: "Finding lost stellacorns is easy! It's catching them that's the hard part."

SFD-049.name: Aphelios, Exalted
SFD-049.rulesText:
When you attach an Equipment to me, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn —
• Ready 2 runes.
• Channel 1 rune exhausted.
• Buff a friendly unit.

SFD-050.name: Azir, Ascendant
SFD-050.rulesText: [G]: [Action] — Choose a unit you control. Move me to its location and move it to my original location. If it's is equipped, you may attach one of its Equipment to me. Use only once per turn.

SFD-051.name: Guardian Angel
SFD-051.effectText: If I would die, kill Guardian Angel instead. Heal me, exhaust me, and recall me. [M]+1

SFD-053.name: Janna, Savior
SFD-053.rulesText:
[Reaction]
When you play me, heal your units here, then move an enemy unit from here to its base.

SFD-054.name: Jax, Unmatched
SFD-054.rulesText:
[Deflect]
Each Equipment in your hand has [Quick-Draw].

SFD-055.name: Needlessly Large Yordle
SFD-055.rulesText:
[Shield 5]
[Tank]
I cost [2][G] less for each point you scored from holding this turn.
SFD-055.flavorText: How did a yordle get so big? You're welcome to ask him.

SFD-057.name: Irelia, Fervent
SFD-057.rulesText:
[Deflect]
When you choose or ready me, give me +1[M] this turn.
SFD-057.flavorText: "Do we want to be safe, or free? The choice is ours."

SFD-058.name: Ornn, Blacksmith
SFD-058.rulesText: When you play me or when I hold, look at the top 4 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a gear from among them and draw it. Then recycle the rest.
SFD-058.flavorText: "Gods do not need followers. Followers need gods."

SFD-059.name: Svellsongur
SFD-059.effectText: As this is attached to a unit, copy that unit's text to this Equipment's effect text for as long as this is attached to it. [M]+0
SFD-059.flavorText: "Only the greatest Freljord heroes have weapons made of True Ice!" —Nunu

SFD-060.name: Tianna Crownguard
SFD-060.rulesText:
[Deflect]
While I'm at a battlefield, opponents can't score points.
SFD-060.flavorText: "I will stand for my country, my family, and nothing else."

SFD-061.name: Aspiring Engineer
SFD-061.rulesText: When you play me, return a gear from your trash to your hand.
SFD-061.flavorText: "Before you know it, I'll be running this place."

SFD-062.name: Bubble Bot
SFD-062.rulesText: When you play me, ready another friendly Mech.
SFD-062.flavorText: The first Bubble Bot started as a practical joke in the scrapyard, but the Mark II soon replaced the morning wake-up bell.

SFD-063.name: Chemtech Cask
SFD-063.rulesText: When you play a spell on an opponent's turn, you may exhaust me to play a Gold gear token exhausted.
SFD-063.flavorText:
"Piltover coos over perfumes while Zaun struggles to breathe."
—Renata Glasc

SFD-065.name: Forecaster
SFD-065.flavorText: A good mech pilot has quick reflexes. A great one doesn't need them.

SFD-067.name: Frostcoat Cub
SFD-067.rulesText:
You may pay [B] as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, give a unit -2[M] this turn.
SFD-067.flavorText: In the Freljord, cuteness is just another survival tactic.

SFD-068.name: Gearhead
SFD-068.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
Each Equipment attached to me gives double its base Might bonus.
SFD-068.flavorText: "Some people dream about the future. I'm living it."

SFD-069.name: Plundering Poro
SFD-069.rulesText: When I conquer, play a Gold gear token exhausted.

SFD-070.name: Wages of Pain
SFD-070.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. Play a Gold gear token exhausted.

SFD-071.name: Breakneck Mech
SFD-071.rulesText:
Your Mechs have [Deflect] and [Ganking].
I enter ready if you control another Mech.

SFD-072.name: Dropboarder
SFD-072.rulesText: When you play me, if you control two or more gear, ready me.
SFD-072.flavorText: Piltover prides itself on progress, but the Firelights prove that Zaun is no less inventive.

SFD-074.name: Pickpocket
SFD-074.rulesText: When you play me, you may kill a gear with Energy cost no more than [1]. If you do, play a Gold gear token exhausted.

SFD-075.name: Prize of Progress
SFD-075.rulesText: When you use an activated ability of a gear, give me +1[M] this turn.
SFD-075.flavorText: In Piltover's Progress Day parade, even the floats are groundbreaking innovations.

SFD-076.name: Production Surge
SFD-076.rulesText:
This costs [2] less if you control a Mech.
Play a 3[M] Mech unit token to your base.
Draw 1.
SFD-076.flavorText: When in doubt, make more mechs.

SFD-077.name: Rocket Barrage
SFD-077.rulesText:
[Repeat] [4][B]
Choose one —
• Deal 4 to a unit in a base.
• Kill a gear.

SFD-078.name: Temporal Portal
SFD-078.rulesText: [A], [E]: Give the next spell you play this turn [Repeat] equal to its cost.
SFD-078.flavorText: Those who study history get to choose whether they'll repeat it.

SFD-079.name: Bard, Mercurial
SFD-079.rulesText:
You may exhaust your legend as an addtional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, move any number of your units to an open battlefield.

SFD-080.name: Bellows Breath
SFD-080.rulesText:
[Action]
[Repeat] [1][B]
Deal 1 to up to three units at the same location.
SFD-080.flavorText:
"My work speaks in the roar of flame and the ringing of steel."
—Ornn

SFD-081.name: Card Sharp
SFD-081.rulesText: When you play me, you and each opponent may play a Gold gear token exhausted. For each opponent who did, you play a Gold gear token exhausted.

SFD-082.name: Ezreal, Dashing
SFD-082.rulesText:
When I attack or defend, deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit here.
I don't deal combat damage.
[B]: [Action] — Move me to your base.
SFD-082.flavorText: "Time for a true display of skill."

SFD-083.name: Hextech Anomaly
SFD-083.rulesText: [E]: [Reaction] — Pay any amount of [A] to [Add] that much Energy.
SFD-083.flavorText:
"Hextech promises to transform the present. But progress must not come at the future's expense!"
—Heimerdinger

SFD-084.name: Jayce, Man of Progress
SFD-084.rulesText: When you play me, you may kill a friendly gear. If you do, you may play a gear with Energy cost no more than [7] from hand this turn, ignoring its Energy cost.
SFD-084.flavorText: "This is what the future looks like."

SFD-085.name: Ornn, Forge God
SFD-085.rulesText:
[Deflect 2]
[Weaponmaster]
I have +1[M] for each friendly gear.

SFD-086.name: World Atlas
SFD-086.effectText: When I hold, play two Gold gear tokens exhausted. [M]+2

SFD-087.name: Premonition
SFD-087.flavorText: Wisdom through power, power through wisdom.

SFD-088.name: Renata Glasc, Mastermind
SFD-088.rulesText:
[1][B]: Draw 1.
[4][B][B][B][B], [E]: Score 1 point.
Use my abilities only while I'm at a battlefield.
SFD-088.flavorText: "Progress comes at a price others aren't willing to pay."

SFD-089.name: Rumble, Scrapper
SFD-089.rulesText:
Your Mechs have +1[M].
When I hold, play a 3[M] Mech unit token to your base.

SFD-090.name: The Zero Drive
SFD-090.rulesText:
[Equip] [1][B]
[3][B], Banish this: Play all units banished with this, ignoring their costs.

SFD-091.name: Buhru Captain
SFD-091.rulesText: When you play me, you may draw 1 or buff me.
SFD-091.flavorText: "The Buhru knew these waters long before the flotsam of Bilgewater washed up on our shores. We know them still."

SFD-092.name: Combat Chef
SFD-092.flavorText: "The tastiest soup is the one you eat after almost getting your head chopped off."

SFD-093.name: Dauntless Vanguard
SFD-093.rulesText: You may play me to an occupied enemy battlefield.
SFD-093.flavorText: When the Demacian Elite receive an order, their commander considers the mission complete.

SFD-094.name: Direwing
SFD-094.rulesText: I enter ready if you control another Dragon.
SFD-094.flavorText: A dragon's definition of "prey" is all-inclusive.

SFD-095.name: Doran's Blade
SFD-095.flavorText:
"I guess I could... throw it at someone."
—Miss Fortune

SFD-096.name: Laurent Bladekeeper
SFD-096.flavorText: "This old dog has plenty of tricks already."

SFD-098.name: Sea Monkey
SFD-098.rulesText:
You may pay [1] as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, buff me.

SFD-099.name: Veteran Poro
SFD-099.flavorText:
"Train hard, little poro, and one day you will be strong."
—Braum

SFD-100.name: Yordle Explorer
SFD-100.rulesText: When you play a card with Power cost [A][A] or more, draw 1.
SFD-100.flavorText: "We can't stop yet! We're just getting started!"

SFD-101.name: Fae Dragon
SFD-101.rulesText:
When you play me, buff up to four friendly units.
When you spend a buff, play a Gold gear token exhausted.
SFD-101.flavorText: The fae who guard the boundary of the spirit realm take their job as seriously as they take anything.

SFD-103.name: Jaull-Fish
SFD-103.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
I cost [2] less for each of your [Mighty] units.

SFD-104.name: Petricite Monument
SFD-104.flavorText: Monuments of magic-absorbing petricite serve both to protect the Kingdom of Demacia and to celebrate it.

SFD-105.name: Ruin Runner
SFD-105.rulesText: I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities.

SFD-106.name: Show of Strength
SFD-106.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Draw 1 for each of your [Mighty] units.

SFD-107.name: Strike Down
SFD-107.rulesText: Choose an equipped friendly unit. It deals damage equal to its Might to an enemy unit. Then detach an Equipment from it.

SFD-109.name: Akshan, Mischievous
SFD-109.rulesText:
[Weaponmaster]
You may pay [O][O] as an addtional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, move an enemy gear to your base. You control it until I leave the board. If it's an Equipment, attach it to me.

SFD-110.name: Fiora, Peerless
SFD-110.rulesText: When I attack or defend one on one, double my Might this combat.

SFD-111.name: Here to Help
SFD-111.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
You may play a unit from hand to a battlefield you control, reducing its cost by [3].

SFD-112.name: Kato the Arm
SFD-112.rulesText:
[Deflect]
When I move to a battlefield, give a friendly unit my keywords and +[M] equal to my Might this turn.

SFD-113.name: Lucian, Merciless
SFD-113.rulesText:
[Weaponmaster]
The first time I conquer each turn, ready me.
SFD-113.flavorText: "One of us finds peace. One of us walks away."

SFD-114.name: Marching Orders
SFD-114.rulesText:
[Action]
[Repeat] [3]
Choose a friendly unit anywhere and an enemy unit at a battlefield. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.

SFD-116.name: Yone, Blademaster
SFD-116.rulesText:
[Weaponmaster]
When I conquer an open battlefield, deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit in a base.

SFD-117.name: Ancient Henge
SFD-117.rulesText: [E]: [Reaction] — Pay any amount of energy to [Add] that much [A].
SFD-117.flavorText: "It's not enough to protect a pile of ice and stone. We must protect each other, and build a community on the foundations our ancestors left." —Ashe

SFD-118.name: Boneshiver
SFD-118.effectText: When I conquer, channel 1 rune exhausted. [M]+2

SFD-119.name: Jax, Unrelenting
SFD-119.rulesText:
[Weaponmaster]
When you attach an Equipment to me, you may pay [1] to draw 1.

SFD-120.name: Sivir, Ambitious
SFD-120.rulesText:
[Deflect 2]
When I conquer after an attack, if you assigned 5 or more excess damage to enemy units, you may deal that much to an enemy unit.
SFD-120.flavorText: "Honor is the rust on a dull blade."

SFD-121.name: Black Market Broker
SFD-121.rulesText: When you play a card from facedown, play a Gold gear token exhausted.
SFD-121.flavorText: "Top of the line. Never used. And no pesky licenses to worry about."

SFD-122.name: Called Shot
SFD-122.rulesText:
[Action]
[Repeat] [P]
Look at the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. Draw one and recycle the other.

SFD-123.name: Corrupt Enforcer
SFD-123.rulesText:
When I move to a battlefield, discard 1.
When I win a combat, draw 1.
SFD-123.flavorText: In his eyes, the law binds but does not protect.

SFD-124.name: Doran's Ring
SFD-124.effectText: When I conquer, discard 1, then draw 1. [M]+1

SFD-125.name: Fae Porter
SFD-125.rulesText: When I move to a battlefield, you may pay [P] to move a unit you control to the same battlefield.

SFD-126.name: Loyal Pup
SFD-126.rulesText: When you defend at a battlefield, you may move me there.

SFD-127.name: Master Bingwen
SFD-127.flavorText: "Perceive your own weakness, before your opponent does."

SFD-128.name: Overzealous Fan
SFD-128.rulesText: When I defend, you may kill me to move an attacking unit to its base.
SFD-128.flavorText: "Like Draven says... Hit 'em where it hurts!"

SFD-129.name: Temptation
SFD-129.rulesText:
[Repeat] [2]
Move an enemy unit to a location where there's a unit with the same controller.

SFD-130.name: Treasure Hunter
SFD-130.rulesText: When I move, play a Gold gear token exhausted.

SFD-131.name: Ancient Warmonger
SFD-131.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
I have [Assault] equal to the number of enemy units here.

SFD-132.name: Beast Below
SFD-132.rulesText: When you play me, return another friendly unit and an enemy unit to their owners' hands.

SFD-134.name: Cull
SFD-134.effectText: When I conquer, play a Gold gear token exhausted. [M]+1

SFD-135.name: Factory Recall
SFD-135.rulesText:
[Action]
Return a gear to its owner's hand.

SFD-136.name: Hard Bargain
SFD-136.rulesText:
[Reaction]
[Repeat] [2]
Counter a spell unless its controller pays [2].

SFD-137.name: Harpoon Squad
SFD-137.rulesText: When I move from a battlefield, give me +2[M] this turn.
SFD-137.flavorText: No room for fear on the boat.

SFD-138.name: Windsinger
SFD-138.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When you play me, you may return another unit at a battlefield with 3[M] or less to its owner's hand.
SFD-138.flavorText: She never sticks around for encores.

SFD-139.name: Edge of Night
SFD-139.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When you play this from facedown, attach it to a unit you control here.
[Equip] [P]

SFD-140.name: Fizz, Trickster
SFD-140.rulesText: When you play me, you may play a spell from your trash with Energy cost no more than [3], ignoring its Energy cost. Recycle that spell after you play it.

SFD-141.name: Irelia, Graceful
SFD-141.rulesText: Your spells that choose me cost [1] or [A] less.
SFD-141.flavorText: "None can do what I do, so I will do it."

SFD-142.name: Jae Medarda
SFD-142.rulesText: When you choose me with a spell, draw 1.
SFD-142.flavorText: A scion of the m ilitant Medarda family, Jae seeks enchanted treasure rather than power or glory.

SFD-143.name: Sivir, Mercenary
SFD-143.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
If you've spent at least [A][A] this turn, I have +2[M] and [Ganking].

SFD-144.name: Spirit Wheel
SFD-144.rulesText: When you choose a friendly unit, you may pay [1] and exhaust this to draw 1.

SFD-145.name: Switcheroo
SFD-145.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Swap the Mights of two units at the same battlefield this turn.
SFD-145.flavorText: Always look out for the little guy.

SFD-146.name: Vex, Cheerless
SFD-146.rulesText: While I'm in combat, friendly spells cost [1][A] less to a minimum of [1], and enemy spells cost [1][A] more.

SFD-147.name: Downwell
SFD-147.rulesText: Return all units and gear to their owners' hands.
SFD-147.flavorText: Sunk costs have a very painful definition in Bilgewater Bay.

SFD-148.name: Draven, Audacious
SFD-148.rulesText:
[Deflect]
The first time I win a combat each turn, you score 1 point.
When I die in combat, choose an opponent. They score 1 point.

SFD-149.name: Ezreal, Prodigy
SFD-149.rulesText:
When you play me, discard 1, then draw 2.
Optional addtional costs you pay cost [1] or [A] less.

SFD-150.name: Last Rites
SFD-150.effectText: Whenever I conquer or hold, you may play a unit from your trash.

SFD-151.name: Bonds of Strength
SFD-151.rulesText:
[Reaction]
[Repeat] [2]
Give 2 friendly units each +1[M] this turn.
SFD-151.flavorText: A vow is stronger than the words that make it.

SFD-152.name: Eminent Benefactor
SFD-152.rulesText: When I hold, play two Gold gear tokens exhausted.
SFD-152.flavorText: Few things are more costly than free money.

SFD-153.name: Eye of the Herald
SFD-153.effectText: When I move, play a 1[M] Recruit unit token here. [M]+0

SFD-154.name: Guards!
SFD-154.rulesText:
[Hidden]
Play a 2[M] Sand Soldier unit token. You may pay [Y] to ready it.
SFD-154.flavorText:
"My empire lives in every grain of sand."
—Azir

SFD-155.name: Honest Broker
SFD-155.rulesText: [Deathknell] — Play a Gold gear token exhausted.

SFD-156.name: Laurent Duelist
SFD-156.flavorText: "No, my old foil, this isn't revenge—it's épéeback."

SFD-157.name: Royal Guard
SFD-157.rulesText: When you play me, play a 2[M] Sand Solider unit token here.
SFD-157.flavorText: A ruler's true power is in the loyalty they inspire.

SFD-158.name: Sandshifter
SFD-158.rulesText: When you play me, kill an enemy unit with 3[M] or less.
SFD-158.flavorText: "Recognize your emperor... or the sands will make you."

SFD-159.name: Trusty Ramhound
SFD-159.rulesText: While you have another unit here, I have +1[M].
SFD-159.flavorText: It's always best to have a dog in the fight.

SFD-160.name: Zaun Punk
SFD-160.rulesText:
You may kill a friendly gear as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, kill a gear.
SFD-160.flavorText: The guitar isn't the only thing he shreds.

SFD-162.name: Blood Money
SFD-162.rulesText:
[Action]
Kill a unit at a battlefield with 2[M] or less. If was an enemy unit, play a Gold gear token exhausted. If it was a friendly unit, play two Gold gear tokens exhausted.
SFD-162.flavorText: Even among the unscrupulous, betrayal costs extra.

SFD-163.name: Deathgrip
SFD-163.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Kill a friendly unit to give +[M] equal to its Might to another friendly unit this turn. Draw 1.

SFD-164.name: Drag Under
SFD-164.rulesText:
[Action]
I cost [2] less to play from anywhere other than your hand.
Kill a unit at a battlefield.
SFD-164.flavorText:
"If we hurry, we can reach the oasis by nightfall."
—Common last words

SFD-165.name: Glasc Mixologist
SFD-165.rulesText: [Deathknell] — You may play a unit with cost no more than [3] and no more than [A] from your trash, ignoring its cost.
SFD-165.flavorText: "The difference between medicine and poison is the dosage." —Renata Glasc

SFD-166.name: Rally the Troops
SFD-166.rulesText:
[Action]
When a friendly unit is played htis turn, buff it.
Draw 1.

SFD-167.name: Unsung Hero
SFD-167.flavorText: She gave everything she had for the cause—even her legacy.

SFD-168.name: Vanguard Armory
SFD-168.flavorText: It takes more than a sword and shield to make a soldier. But it's a good start.

SFD-169.name: Altar of Memories
SFD-169.rulesText: When a friendly unit dies, you may exhaust me to draw 1, then put a card from your hand on the top or bottom of your Main Deck.

SFD-170.name: Rek'Sai, Swarm Queen
SFD-170.rulesText: When I attack, you may reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may play one. Then recycle the rest. If the played card is a unit, you may play it here.

SFD-171.name: Renata Glasc, Industrialist
SFD-171.flavorText: "Nothing's free. All I ask is your loyalty."

SFD-173.name: Soraka, Wanderer
SFD-173.rulesText:
I must be assigned combat damage last.
If another unit you control here would die, if it has less Might than me, instead heal it, exhaust it, and recall it.

SFD-174.name: Trove Golem
SFD-174.rulesText: When you play me, play four Gold gear tokens exhausted.
SFD-174.flavorText: As expensive as it is expansive.

SFD-175.name: Undertitan
SFD-175.rulesText:
When you play me, give your other units +2[M] this turn.
As I'm revealed from your deck, [Add] [2].

SFD-176.name: Xin Zhao, Vigilant
SFD-176.rulesText:
[Tank]
I enter ready if you have two or more other units in your base.

SFD-177.name: Azir, Sovereign
SFD-177.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
When I attack, you may move any number of your token units to this battlefield.
SFD-177.flavorText: "You need not follow, but you must witness."

SFD-178.name: Blade of the Ruined King
SFD-178.flavorText:
"You are not the hero of this tale."
—Viego

SFD-179.name: Corina Veraza
SFD-179.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
When I move to a battlefield, play three 1[M] Recruit unit tokens here.
SFD-179.flavorText: "I told them that every achievement had its cost. I didn't tell them who would pay it."

SFD-180.name: Fiora, Worthy
SFD-180.rulesText: Whenever a unit you control becomes [Mighty], you may pay [Y] to ready it.

SFD-184.name: Relentless Pursuit
SFD-184.rulesText:
[Action]
Move a friendly unit. You may attach an Equipment with the same controller to it. This turn, that unit has "When I conquer, you may move me to my base."

SFD-185.name: Draven, Glorious Executioner
SFD-185.rulesText: When you win a combat, draw 1.

SFD-187.name: Rek'Sai, Void Burrower
SFD-187.rulesText: When you conquer, you may exhaust me to reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may play one. Then recycle the rest.

SFD-188.name: Void Rush
SFD-188.rulesText: Reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may play one of them, reducing its cost by [2]. Draw any you did not play this way.

SFD-189.name: Ornn, Fire Below the Mountain
SFD-189.rulesText: [E]: [Reaction] — [Add] [A]. Use only to play gear or use gear abilities.

SFD-190.name: Forgefire Cape
SFD-190.effectText: When I attack or defend, deal 2 to all enemy units here. [M]+3

SFD-191.name: Rabadon's Deathcrown
SFD-191.effectText: Your spells and abilities deal 1 Bonus Damage. [M]+3

SFD-192.name: Shurelya's Requiem
SFD-192.rulesText:
[Unique]
[Equip] [A]
When you play this, ready your units.

SFD-193.name: Jax, Grandmaster at Arms
SFD-193.rulesText:
[1], [E]: Attach a detached Equipment you control to a unit you control.
[E]. Attach an attached Equipment you control to a unit you control.

SFD-194.name: Counter Strike
SFD-194.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose a unit. The next time that unit would be dealt damage this turn, prevent it. Draw 1.

SFD-195.name: Irelia, Blade Dancer
SFD-195.rulesText:
When you choose a friendly unit, you may exhaust me and pay [A] to ready it.
When you conquer, you may pay [1] to ready me.

SFD-196.name: Defiant Dance
SFD-196.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Give a unit +2[M] this turn and another unit -2[M] this turn.
SFD-196.flavorText:
"I am both the tranquil sea and the tempest."
—Irelia

SFD-197.name: Azir, Emperor of the Sands
SFD-197.rulesText:
Your Sand Soldiers have [Weaponmaster].
[1], [E]: Play a 2[M] Sand Soldier unit token to your base. Use only if you've played an Equipment this turn.

SFD-198.name: Arise!
SFD-198.rulesText: Play a 2[M] Sand Soldier unit token for each Equipment you control. Then ready two of them.

SFD-199.name: Ezreal, Prodigal Explorer
SFD-199.rulesText: [E]: [Reaction] — Draw 1. Use only if you've chosen enemy units and/or gear twice this turn with spells or unit abilities.

SFD-200.name: Arcane Shift
SFD-200.rulesText:
[Action]
Banish a friendly unit, then its controller plays it, ignoring its cost. Deal 3 to an enemy unit at a battlefield. Banish this.
SFD-200.flavorText:
"Hah! I can blink and still not miss."
—Ezreal

SFD-201.name: Renata Glasc, Chem-Baroness
SFD-201.rulesText:
When you or an ally hold, you may exhaust me to play a Gold gear token exhausted.
While your score is within 3 points of the Victory Score, your Gold [Add] an additional [1].

SFD-202.name: Hostile Takeover
SFD-202.rulesText:
[Hidden]
Take control of an enemy unit at a battlefield. Ready it.
Lose control of that unit and recall it at end of turn.

SFD-203.name: Sivir, Battle Mistress
SFD-203.rulesText:
When you recycle a rune, you may exhaust me to play a Gold gear token exhausted.
When one or more enemy units die, ready me.

SFD-205.name: Fiora, Grand Duelist
SFD-205.rulesText: When one of your units becomes [Mighty], you may exhaust me to channel 1 rune exhausted.

SFD-206.name: Riposte
SFD-206.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose a friendly unit and a spell. Counter that spell give that unit +[M] equal to the spell's Energy cost this turn.

SFD-207.name: Emperor's Dais
SFD-207.rulesText: When you conquer here, you may pay [1] and return a unit you control here to its owner's hand. If you do, play a 2[M] Sand Soldier unit token here.

SFD-208.name: Forge of the Fluft
SFD-208.rulesText: While you control this battlefield, friendly legends have "[E]: Attach an Equipment you control to a unit you control."

SFD-209.name: Forgotten Monument
SFD-209.rulesText: Players cannot score here until their third turn.

SFD-210.name: Hall of Legends
SFD-210.rulesText: When you conquer here, you may pay [1] to ready your legend.

SFD-211.name: Marai Spire
SFD-211.rulesText: While you control this battlefield, friendly [Repeat] costs cost [1] less.

SFD-212.name: Minefield
SFD-212.rulesText: When you conquer here, put the top 2 cards of your Main Deck into your trash.

SFD-213.name: Ornn's Forge
SFD-213.rulesText: While you control this battlefield, the first friendly non-token gear played each turn costs [1] less.

SFD-214.name: Power Nexus
SFD-214.rulesText: When you hold here, you may pay [A][A][A][A] to score 1 point.

SFD-215.name: Ravenbloom Conservatory
SFD-215.rulesText: When you defend here, reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's a spell, put it in your hand. Otherwise, recycle it.

SFD-217.name: Seat of Power
SFD-217.rulesText: When you conquer here, draw 1 for each other battlefield you or allies control.

SFD-218.name: Sunken Temple
SFD-218.rulesText: When you conquer here with one or more [Mighty] units, you may [1] to draw 1.

SFD-219.name: The Papertree
SFD-219.rulesText: When you hold here, each player channels 1 rune exhausted.

SFD-220.name: Treasure Hoard
SFD-220.rulesText: When you conquer here, you may pay [1] to play a Gold gear token exhausted.

SFD-221.name: Veiled Temple
SFD-221.rulesText: When you conquer here, you may ready a friendly gear. If it's an Equipment, you may detach it.

SFD-T01.name: Mech
SFD-T01.flavorText: Sure, they're loud, messy, and unreliable. But so are people, when you get down to it.

SFD-T02.name: Sand Soldier
SFD-T02.flavorText: They do not rest. They do not hesitate. And they do not yield.
